summary.headline: Medical Astrology and Inceptions
summary.text: Methods for medical astrology: a numerical procedure using the Dog Star’s rising and a 36-part table to predict whether a sick person will recover, face danger, or die, attributed to Petosiris, Pythagoras, and Hermes Trismegistus. A further method by Zenarion determines the ruler of an inception day and hour through divisions by seven and planetary sequences.
